facts_of_case: Marriage of parties solemnised on 20.04.2008; two children born from out of the wedlock; parties residing separately since October, 2014; petition for divorce filed by husband under Section 13 (1) (ia) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 dismissed by trial court.

legal_principles.principle: Condonation of delay in filing appeal is possible if the delay is not substantial.
legal_principles.held: The learned counsel for the appellant shall give a written intimation of the next date of hearing.

legal_principles.principle: Appellant's counsel must ensure service of intimation on the respondent's counsel.
legal_principles.held: However, the respondent is not present. No effort has been made to effect service on the counsel, who was appearing for the respondent before the learned Family Court.

outcome.final_order: Appellant shall give a written intimation of the next date of hearing along with a complete set of the paperbook to the counsel who was appearing for the respondent in the Family Court.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act
condoning delay in filing an appeal
notifying the opposite party through speed post and telephone
